capabilities.description: Set of capabilities that the provider will have. Cannot be changed after creation.
capabilities.title: Capabilities

default.description: Whether the new provider should the default provider. Has no effect if enable is false.
default.title: Default

enable.description: Enable the new provider for the default project for the group/global settings.
enable.title: Enable

inputs.description: Input values that can be accessed in the template.
inputs.title: Inputs

name.description: The name can be used to identify the provider instead of the id. It is case-sensitive, unique and can only contain letters, numbers and dashes.
name.title: Name

projectId.description: Limit access to the provider to a given project.
projectId.title: Projectid

redTeam.description: Mark provider for use in attack campaigns.
redTeam.title: Redteam

requestConcurrencyLimit.description: Specifies concurrency limits for requests from campaign run attacks.

secrets.description: Secrets that can be accessed in the template.
secrets.title: Secrets

systemProvider.description: ID or name of the system provider to use the template from.
systemProvider.title: Systemprovider

tag.description: Optional tag to attach to the provider.
tag.title: Tag

test.description: Whether to test the provider connection before creation.
test.title: Test

decayPerSecond.description:
Number of request slots that are opened per second.

Set a value to use the concurrency limit as a rate limit.

For example, to set a rate limit of 5 requests per second set requests=5 and decayPerSecond=5
decayPerSecond.title: Decaypersecond

requests.description: Max number of request slots that can be occupied at once.
requests.title: Requests
